registration_scope: Explicit new exploratory ablation selected AFTER seeing late6 success and late11 failure; not part of initial preregistration and not blind validation.
hypothesis: Does the earlier nine-call interval 6..14 retain timing benefit when compared with the later nine-call interval 11..19, rather than merely having more intervened calls?
confound_in_existing_comparison: late6 6..19 has14 routed calls; late11 11..19 has9. Onset, count, raw-sigma span and trajectory history all differ.

matched_variables.Qwen_prompt_and_reference_preparation: byte-for-byte same graph values as late6

pre_analysis_integrity_gates: Require successful history, complete20forward calls and 450 routed block calls only at calls6..14; all50blocks each selected call, no route at15..19.
Actual prepared reference, conditioning embedding/tags/layout, target latent shape and noise tensor hashes must match native/late6/late11; graph equality alone is insufficient.
x0 step005 VIDEO AND AUDIO must be exactly equal to native and late6 tensor contents because no intervention has occurred.
Additional identical-prefix sanity: x0 step010 video/audio must be exactly equal to late6, since both schedules have identical inputs and intervention through call10.
If any integrity gate fails, classify as invalid/confounded run; do not interpret timing as the planned ablation.

evaluation.original_endpoint: final RGB pose alignment; x0 is diagnostic, not a replacement for the final endpoint
evaluation.positive_lag_definition: edited motion occurs later; physical video frames, not denoising calls
evaluation.existing_coverage_shape_multipeak_gates: Use frozen local_diagnostic unchanged; all unknowns and warnings retained. Do not replace a missing primary result with a favorable auxiliary feature.
evaluation.complete_target_alignment: Both threshold primary main-window reliable lags within +/-2 frames, frozen shape/error gates passed, same-frame error reported and no gross appearance/background/edit failure.
evaluation.partial_timing_benefit: Reliable main-window delay reduced by at least4 frames versus native at both thresholds, lower same-frame error, no gross edit failure; not complete rescue.
evaluation.no_demonstrated_benefit: Otherwise; unknown/confounded is not proof of impossibility.
quality_gate: Sam identity/outfit retained rather than source identity copied
No gross room/background/camera or body deformation failure
Review fixed frames55 and86 consistently with prior screen; if relying only on this screen state that it is not full quality validation
Report all frozen windows and full-clip/common-support ancillary diagnostics; correlated events are not independent replications

interpretation.earlier9_better_than_later9: Supports schedule location/history dependence at equal intervened-call count for this selected case. It does not prove an early critical interval, a complete response curve, a live feedback controller or new architecture.
interpretation.earlier9_similar_to_earlier14: Suggests the late tail15..19 was not necessary for this endpoint under this trajectory; does not establish universal dispensability.
interpretation.earlier9_worse_than_earlier14: Consistent with duration/tail/path dependence, not a clean attribution to any one factor.
interpretation.equal_call_count_is_not_equal_dose: Earlier9 and later9 have different raw sigma spans, model noise coordinates, attention states and propagated effects. Even with450 routed block calls each, correction magnitudes and runtime may differ.
interpretation.limited_coverage: One discovered source/identity/seed; earlier9 and later9 overlap in calls11..14. No start-time sweep, no monotonicity or exact controllability boundary claim.
interpretation.observer_separation: Static schedule only; original step005 primary observer remains unknown. A successful fixed early schedule does not demonstrate online observation/control overlap.

runtime_scope: No remote queue or live runtime changed by this staging task. Root independently reviews and decides whether to append; preserve exact process admission, auto cleanup and VRAM release.
